hook: Ultra-high-energy cosmic rays carry too many heavy nuclei to match any known seed population.
hook_turn: to match any known seed population.
summary: Fits to Pierre Auger Observatory data, evaluated at fixed rigidity, give two families of composition solutions. Only one lets the source hydrogen abundance match that of low-energy cosmic rays, yet both need an excess of silicon-iron group nuclei. The result depends on the assumed source and propagation models used in the fits.
title: Ultra-high-energy cosmic rays require metal-rich sources
